Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Within the Information Systems Department, the DevOps Engineer acts as a key technical expert in
 application operations, integration, and production readiness.
 The role serves as the technical interface between Development, Infrastructure, DevOps, and
 Production teams, ensuring applications are deployed, operated, and maintained according to
 standards of performance, resilience, security, and service continuity.
 💻 What you will do: 
 Application Integration & Technical Expertise: Act as the technical reference point for application
 integration and operational readiness; contribute to technical architecture design; analyze
 infrastructure impacts; support project teams; participate in technical documentation validation.
 Project Delivery & DevOps: Contribute to estimations and planning; support CI/CD initiatives;
 automate environments using Infrastructure as Code; ensure successful deployment and
 post-production support; maintain operational documentation.
 Production Readiness & Operational Excellence: Guarantee operability, monitoring, backup,
 resilience and security requirements; lead technical validation and certification activities; ensure
 compliance with operational standards.
 Operational Support & Incident Management: Provide L3 support; manage incidents and problems;
 perform root cause analysis; coordinate patch management; participate in continuity and disaster
 recovery exercises.
 Platform & Continuous Improvement: Promote automation, standardization and operational
 excellence; improve deployment and operational processes; contribute to platform evolution.
 💡 REQUIRED PROFILE 
 • Kubernetes
 • DevOps Practices
 • Ansible / AWX
 • Terraform
 • Monitoring & Alerting Tools
 • Application Production Support (L3)
 • High Availability & Resilience Design
 • Agile Methodologies
 AWS Cloud Services
 • Linux Administration
 • Docker
 • Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
 • CI/CD Pipelines
 • Git & Version Control
 • Python
 • Shell Scripting
 • ElasticSearch
 • French B1
 Other skills: 
 • Strong customer and service orientation
 • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
 • Ability to anticipate risks and proactively escalate issues
 • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 • Autonomy and initiative
 • Ability to work in Agile and cross-functional environments
 • Commitment to delivery deadlines and operational excellence
 WHY JOIN US: 
 Here, you will find a flexible workplace and culture, autonomy, constant learning opportunities, dynamism, and talented people, making this experience a real career accelerator. You will also discover all the diversity of our businesses, in a sector that is constantly evolving and innovating.
 If you feel like ambitiously pursuing your goals, then you have come to the right place.
 Plus, you will enjoy all our benefits: 
competitive compensation & remuneration, including annual performance bonus;
preventive healthcare plan, and group health & life insurance;
wide range of flexible benefits within a monthly budget;
office perks, wellbeing and mental health programs;
various social benefits and bonuses for personal or family events;
additional paid and unpaid time off, including Sabbatical leave;
learning and growth opportunities based on individual development and career plans;
unlimited access to various eLearning resources.
